user.title: Connect HA Monitor
user.description: Enter the HTTPS base URL of your Laravel server and a new pairing code from its instance page. Codes expire after ten minutes and can be used once. If a response is lost, create a new code before trying again.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect HA Monitor
reauth_confirm.description: The agent token was revoked or is invalid. Create a new pairing code for the same instance in Laravel, then enter it here. Issuing a code immediately invalidates the previous token.

reconfigure.title: Change receiver or pair again
reconfigure.description: Enter the receiver URL and a new pairing code for the same instance UUID. To connect a different instance, add a separate integration. Pairing consumes the code even if its instance does not match.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTPS base URL without credentials, query parameters or a fragment. A path prefix is supported.
error.invalid_code: The pairing code must contain exactly 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
error.invalid_auth: The code is invalid, expired, already used, or its instance is disabled. Create a new code in Laravel.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the receiver. Check the address and network. If the code may have been consumed, create a new one.
error.server_error: The receiver reported a temporary error. If the code may have been consumed, create a new one before trying again.
error.rate_limited: The receiver is rate limiting requests. Wait at least {retry_after} seconds before trying again.
error.tls_error: TLS certificate verification failed. Correct the receiver's certificate, certificate chain, hostname or trusted CA configuration.
error.forbidden: The receiver refused this request. Check its HTTPS ingress, trusted proxy configuration and instance configuration.
error.invalid_response: The receiver returned an incompatible or incomplete response. Check that it implements protocol v1. If pairing consumed the code, create a new one.
error.protocol_error: The receiver rejected this request. Check the server URL, protocol version and receiver configuration. Create a new code if needed.

abort.already_configured: This instance is already configured. Use Reconfigure to pair it again.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The code belongs to a different instance. The existing entry was left unchanged. Create a new code for the correct instance; the submitted code has been consumed.

init.title: Monitoring and transmission
init.description: Local collection runs every 60 seconds independently of the server. Monitoring transmission is initially off. Automatic collection includes all enabled update entities, including those without installation support; disabled sources are not enabled. Manual selection can additionally require specific sources to be monitored. CPU/RAM describe the visible OS. Snapshot v1 can transmit only 100 available updates and restricted version strings; missing sources or incompatible data are indicated in the local update sensor and diagnostics. Pausing stops both uploads; local collection continues. Changes reload the integration and discard retry buffers.

invalid_auth.message: The HA Monitor agent token is invalid or revoked. Pair this instance again with a new code.

upload_blocked.title: HA Monitor uploads have stopped
upload_blocked.description: The receiver or local payload failed a permanent check: {reason}. No unchanged uploads will be retried. Check the receiver's protocol v1 compatibility, instance UUID, HTTPS ingress, certificate chain and system clocks. For HTTP 400/413/415/422, correct the receiver/payload compatibility; for 403, correct ingress or instance configuration. Correct the cause, then reload the integration. Use Reconfigure with a new pairing code if the receiver URL or credentials changed. TLS certificate verification cannot be disabled.

monitoring_blocked.title: HA Monitor monitoring uploads stopped
monitoring_blocked.description: Monitoring Snapshot v1 failed: {reason}. HTTP 404 means the monitoring receiver is absent; 409 means a snapshot ID was reused with changed content. Correct compatibility, HTTPS or clock settings, then reload. Local collection and heartbeats continue independently.
